Thank you for your interest in Green Streets Citizens' Assembly

The assembly will look at the following question: 

"What should be done to make every street in the city greener?"

The assembly will be held on the following dates and times:

  • Saturday 14 November 10am – 4pm
  • Sunday 15 November 10am – 4pm 
  • Saturday 21 November 10am – 5:30pm
  • Sunday 22 November 10am - 4pm

The first two sessions will be held online, the final two sessions will be held in person in Birmingham.

Everyone who takes part will receive £350 as a thank you for your time. If there is anything we can do to help you to take part, we are happy to discuss this with you, even if you do not have a video device or an internet connection. Please register for the event whatever your situation, and someone will be in touch if you are selected to take part.

If you need help registering or have other questions please call our Freephone number 0808 157 0123. Lines are open 8am–8pm every day. You can also email questions to hello@civic-lottery.example.org . 

IMPORTANT NOTES:

  • Everyone who registers online must have their own email address. If you do not have an email address, please ring the Freephone number above to register.

  • All fields marked with an asterisk (*) must be completed.

  • We will share all your details with Common Ground Research, the organisation running this event. They will make a separate data agreement with you if you are selected to take part. Your data will be kept strictly confidential. We will delete your details one year after the event ends, unless you tell us otherwise below. Please read our Privacy Policy for more details.

  • You can withdraw your consent at any time and ask us to delete your data, or request a copy of it, by emailing privacy@civic-lottery.example.org. If you ask us to delete your data, we will tell the other organisation(s) listed above to do the same.
